editorial.blurb: The Dime is a spacious Big Ten bar on Lincoln Ave with good food, cold beer, and an energetic vibe perfect for catching the game or hanging with friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit their Friday special: $25 for a double cheeseburger with waffle fries and two hours of unlimited beer—a solid deal for the neighborhood.
signatureDishes: Chicken sandwich stuffed with Mac n cheese

topDishes.note: On par with Chicago's best, the standout order
Solid Friday special with crispy fries, though the pretzel bun runs salty
